svg.font-family: Lato, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, 'Liberation Sans', sans-serif

text.font-family: 'Playfair Display', Georgia, 'Times New Roman', 'Liberation Serif', serif
text.tspan: SARS-CoV-2 variants in analyzed sequences France
The number of analyzed sequences in the preceding two weeks that correspond to each variant group. This
number may not reflect the complete breakdown of cases since only a fraction of all cases are sequenced.

tspan.tspan: Recently-discovered or actively-monitored variants may be overrepresented, as suspected cases of these variants are likely to be

text.tspan: sequenced preferentially or faster than other cases.
